changelog:
- Initial release of the harness-engineering skill, providing comprehensive engineering specifications for building harness agents.
- Outlines the Agent Harness architecture: agent loop core with 7 Rings (Provider, Tools, Permissions, Session, Compaction, Prompts & Skills, Extensions) plus Delivery.
- Includes detailed design decisions, runnable Python code templates, long-running agent patterns, and main harness comparisons.
- Offers phase-based build checklists, implementation guidelines, and core engineering principles for coding, automation, or long-running agents.
- Clearly scopes the skill as a reference for standards and templates, not for code execution or project modification.
summary: Agent Harness 构建规范——当 AI 通过编程构建 harness agent（coding agent / 自动化 agent / 长时运行 agent）时，读取本 skill 作为参考标准，确保产出符合 harness 工程架构：Loop / Provider / Tools / Permissions / Session / Compaction / Prompts & Skills / Extensions 七层 + Delivery。覆盖设计决策、可运行 Python 代码模板、长时运行模式。触发词：coding agent、agent loop、tool calling、context management、session persistence、agent harness、构建 agent。Use this skill when the user asks to build a coding agent / automation agent / long-running agent / agent harness.
